**Direct answer:** No. Public evidence can't establish NVIDIA's exact realized AI-chip share in 2030. The question assumes an outcome that doesn't exist yet. Today is 2026-10-28, 2030 hasn't happened, and I found no source reporting a 2030 result. Only projections exist, and even the current share is estimated inconsistently.

**Observed (2024–2026), all estimates rather than audited figures**

- Estimates of NVIDIA's current share range from about 70% to about 85%, depending on source and definition.
  - Tom's Hardware says about 70%: https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/semiconductors/custom-ai-asics-examined-from-broadcom-to-mtia
  - Silicon Analysts says about 80% by revenue, citing $193.7B in FY2026 data-center sales: https://siliconanalysts.com/analysis/amd-vs-nvidia-ai-gpu-market-share-2026
  - Denkstrom says about 85% in early 2026: https://denkstrom.org/en/goodnews/ai-chips-asic-gpu-market-shift/
- Silicon Analysts' year-by-year table puts NVIDIA at about 87% in 2024 (its peak) and about 75% for 2026. It labels 2025 and 2026 as estimates and says it synthesizes Bloomberg Intelligence, IDC and its own figures: https://siliconanalysts.com/analysis/amd-vs-nvidia-ai-gpu-market-share-2026
- Revenue share and shipment share give different answers. TrendForce, as cited by Denkstrom, expects GPUs' share of AI servers to fall from 83% to 70% in 2026 as ASICs rise from about 15% to nearly 28%. Tom's Hardware reports similar ASIC shipment figures: https://denkstrom.org/en/goodnews/ai-chips-asic-gpu-market-shift/ and https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/semiconductors/custom-ai-asics-examined-from-broadcom-to-mtia

**Projections (not outcomes)**

- Analysts expect AMD to reach 10–20% by 2030, which would imply a lower NVIDIA share: https://denkstrom.org/en/goodnews/ai-chips-asic-gpu-market-shift/
- Tom's Hardware says NVIDIA's roughly 70% share is "projected to erode" as hyperscalers build custom chips. It gives no specific 2030 figure: https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/semiconductors/custom-ai-asics-examined-from-broadcom-to-mtia
- A search summary attributed Bloomberg Intelligence with 70–75% for NVIDIA through 2030, and TrendForce with ASIC servers near 40% of shipments by 2030. I could not verify either. Bloomberg's page returned HTTP 403, and I didn't read the TrendForce source. Treat both as unconfirmed.

**What the evidence shows about the premise**

- Even if 2030 data existed, "AI-chip market share" has no standard definition. Sources differ on revenue versus units, merchant versus captive chips, and chip versus system. The 70–85% spread for today comes from those differences. Source: the three links in the first observed bullet.

**Gaps**

- I used five of eight retrievals. The Bloomberg and TrendForce primary figures are unread.
- The 2030 AMD and ASIC projections come from one secondary blog, so they are weakly corroborated.
- I did not find a dated 2030 forecast from a primary analyst source.

Sources:
- https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/semiconductors/custom-ai-asics-examined-from-broadcom-to-mtia
- https://siliconanalysts.com/analysis/amd-vs-nvidia-ai-gpu-market-share-2026
- https://denkstrom.org/en/goodnews/ai-chips-asic-gpu-market-shift/
